items.question: How does CodaAI work alongside agencies and marketing teams?
items.answer: CodaAI is built on the Co-Creation principle: human expertise steers, AI scales. Agencies and marketing teams bring strategic know-how, industry insight, and audience understanding – the CodaAI team translates that into a structured production process where specialized AI modules handle the repetitive, time-intensive tasks. The result: agency-quality content with machine-level efficiency. Experience that leads. AI that delivers.

items.question: What does 'orchestration by six AI experts' mean?
items.answer: In the Co-Create model, the CodaAI team handles the orchestration: human experts define strategy, tone, and quality standards – the AI executes. Six specialized AI modules each handle their area: Strategy & Planning, Content Writing, Visual Design, SEO & GEO, Video Production, and Distribution. The AI handles the repetitive, scalable work; human expertise ensures relevance, brand consistency, and creative quality. Like a conductor who knows the orchestra and leads every cue with precision.

items.question: How much can I actually save?
items.answer: Up to 88% less than traditional agency fees. A complete content package costs €2,000+ per article at an agency – CodaAI starts from €490*/month with an annual licence. This is possible through the Co-Creation model: human expertise where it truly matters – strategy, quality control, and brand direction. AI automation where scale makes the difference.

items.question: How does it work? What do I need to get started?
items.answer: You are personally guided through the entire process by the CodaAI team. In an initial conversation, our experts get to know your goals, industry, and target audience. The team then takes over strategic planning: topic ideation, editorial calendar, and publication strategy. The six AI specialists accelerate production – from SEO-optimized articles and professional graphics to videos. Co-Creation means: you bring your knowledge, we bring process, structure, and AI-powered delivery.

items.question: What makes CodaAI different from other AI writing tools?
items.answer: Other AI tools generate text – without strategy, without context, without quality control. CodaAI is a Co-Creation system: behind every project stands an expert team that strategically plans your content, orchestrates AI production, and aligns results with your brand. No other tool combines human content expertise so consistently with AI scalability – from planning all the way to publication.

items.question: Is CodaAI suitable for my industry?
items.answer: Yes – for any industry that relies on content marketing. The CodaAI team works together with you to define the right terminology, tone, and relevant topics. The AI specialists adapt accordingly, learning the specifics of your market. From tech startups to established enterprises: in the Co-Creation process, your industry knowledge is always part of the solution.

items.question: What contract terms are available?
items.answer: The minimum contract term is one quarter (3 months). With an annual licence, you save 20% compared to quarterly billing – ideal for content marketing and SEO initiatives that deliver results over time. Cancellation is possible at the end of the chosen billing period (quarterly or annually).

items.question: What happens after I cancel?
items.answer: If you cancel, your subscription ends at the close of your current billing period (quarterly or annual). You retain full rights to all content created during your subscription. There are no hidden fees and no cancellation charges.

items.question: Why should I plan for at least 3–6 months?
items.answer: Content marketing is a long-term investment in your digital visibility – not a sprint. New content first needs to be crawled, indexed, and evaluated by search engines. This process alone takes 2–8 weeks depending on your site and competitive landscape, followed by further weeks during which algorithms observe engagement signals. AI models like ChatGPT or Perplexity also don't update their knowledge base daily – visibility there is built through consistent, citable content published over time. In the Co-Creation approach, this means: publishing consistently and with quality over 6–12 months builds a credible digital presence that search engines and AI systems increasingly recognize. The 3-month minimum is the starting point – sustainable visibility gains typically emerge from 6 months of consistent publication.
